mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase corporate wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0, or the average 20d return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.1 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which translates into higher consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1100.0, or the average 60d return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in the CPIAUCSL signal a disinflationary monetary tightening, which reduces inflation risk and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).
